attachable_object_types.description: Object types that may be attached to a ticket, as `app_label.model` strings. Attaching an object of any other type is refused, and the object picker offers only these types.

llm.description: LLM service layer settings. Providers, models and credentials are registry objects managed in the UI, never settings, so this block holds almost nothing.

usage_retention_days.description: LLM usage records older than this are deleted automatically by the service itself, at most once per process per day.

agent.description: The agent (Phase 4B). Providers, models, MCP servers and tools are registry objects managed in the UI, never settings, so this block holds only the shape of a run.

enabled.description: Whether the agent Job may run at all. Off until a deployment names a provider and a model.

provider.description: LLMProvider name the agent calls. Required when the agent is enabled.

model.description: LLMModel name on that provider. Required when the agent is enabled.

max_iterations.description: Model calls one run may make before it stops with what it has.

max_tool_calls.description: Tool calls across a whole chain of runs, including every resumption after an approval.

max_tool_result_chars.description: How much of one tool's answer is kept, before it is truncated for the prompt and the record.

max_context_chars.description: How much of the ticket's raw payload goes into the prompt.

max_transcript_chars.description: How large a run's transcript may grow before the run stops and says so.

timeout_seconds.description: How long one model call may take.

tool_timeout_seconds.description: How long one tool call may take.

rag.description: Retrieval over closed tickets (Phase 5A). The corpus is built as tickets close and is read by the Similar Tickets panel alone - no retrieved text ever reaches a prompt (rule R9).

enabled.description: Whether closing a ticket indexes it and whether the panel queries. Off until a deployment names an embedding provider and model.

provider.description: LLMProvider name the embedding calls go to. Required when RAG is enabled.

model.description: LLMModel name on that provider, registered with kind `embedding`. A chat model is refused rather than used - rule L8's posture, on a new axis. Required when RAG is enabled.

max_document_chars.description: How much of a ticket's rendered document is embedded, before it is truncated.

similar_count.description: How many neighbours the panel shows at most.

max_distance.description: Cosine distance past which a neighbour is not shown at all: 0 is identical, 2 is opposite. Measured, not guessed - against nomic-embed-text a genuinely related problem scores 0.09-0.10 and unrelated text scores 0.22-0.24. Tune it against your own corpus and model, and err low: a quiet panel is ignored far less than one that cries wolf. See docs/admin/rag.md.

timeout_seconds.description: How long one embedding call may take. Exceeding it fails the indexing, never the close (rule R5).

ingestion.description: Event ingestion. An empty object means the consumer subscribes to nothing, which is the default until a deployment points it at a broker.

consumer.description: Which broker implementation to run. Kafka is the reference; Redis pub/sub is best-effort and loses messages published while the consumer is down.

consumer_name.description: Name this process reports its counters under. Blank means `hostname:pid`.

max_payload_bytes.description: Largest raw event stored on a ticket. A payload over this is replaced by its size and a readable prefix.

event_type_cache_seconds.description: How long the consumer holds the event type catalogue between reads. Disabling an event type takes up to this long to take effect.

max_retries.description: Attempts at a message whose database write fails transiently, before the process exits without acknowledging it.

poll_timeout_seconds.description: How long a poll waits before returning empty, which is also how often the loop can notice a shutdown signal or roll a stats bucket while no traffic is arriving.

stats_bucket_seconds.description: Width of one IngestionStats counter window.

stats_flush_seconds.description: How often in-memory counters are written to the database. Bounds the write rate regardless of the message rate.

stats_retention_days.description: Age at which counter rows are pruned, on bucket rollover.

resolve_cache_seconds.description: How long the enrichment resolver trusts a lookup, hit or miss. An object created since the last read takes up to this long to start resolving.

resolve_cache_entries.description: How many lookups the enrichment resolver holds at once, evicting least recently used. Bounded because the keys come out of the payload.

kafka.description: Kafka connection settings. Requires the `kafka` extra.

bootstrap_servers.description: Broker addresses. Ignored when `external_integration` is set.

group_id.description: Consumer group. Instances sharing it split the partitions between them.

external_integration.description: Name of a Nautobot ExternalIntegration holding the broker URL and its SecretsGroup. Preferred over settings for anything credentialed.

security_protocol.description: Security protocol used when the external integration supplies credentials. Ignored otherwise.

sasl_mechanism.description: SASL mechanism used when the external integration supplies credentials.

url.description: Redis URL. Ignored when `external_integration` is set.

external_integration.description: Name of a Nautobot ExternalIntegration holding the Redis URL and its SecretsGroup.

triage.description: LLM triage of events the pre-filter accepted. Off by default; the provider and model name registry objects, not settings.

enabled.description: Whether accepted events are triaged by a model at all.

provider.description: Name of the LLMProvider to call. Required when enabled.

model.description: Name of the LLMModel on that provider. Required when enabled.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout passed on every triage call. The consumer handles one message at a time, so this bounds worst-case throughput.

max_output_tokens.description: Completion cap for triage answers, which are one small JSON object.

max_context_chars.description: Longest payload JSON included in a triage prompt; anything longer is truncated.

attach_candidates.description: How many open tickets the model is shown as attach candidates.

model_cache_seconds.description: How long a running consumer holds the resolved LLMModel before re-reading it. Bounds how long disabling a provider or model, or correcting its prices, takes to reach a consumer already running.

topics.description: Per-topic configuration, keyed by broker topic or channel name. A topic with no entry here is not consumed.

field_map.description: Where each event field lives in the payload, as dotted paths. `event_type` and `title` are required.

defaults.description: Values used when the payload does not carry them.

severity_map.description: Raw severity values mapped onto the app's scale. Keys are compared as strings, so 4 and "4" behave the same.

dedup_key_template.description: Idempotency key, rendered from `{dotted.path}` placeholders. An unresolvable path yields an empty key, so the event opens its own ticket.

minimum_severity.description: Events below this severity are dropped.

unknown_event_type.description: What to do with an event naming a type the catalogue does not hold.

rate_limit.description: Token bucket, per process. Omit for no limit.

rules.description: Match rules, tried in order. The first whose clauses all match decides.

name.description: Counter key this rule's decisions are recorded under. Unique within the topic.

action.description: `drop` discards the event entirely; `suppress` opens the ticket and puts it straight into the suppressed state.

when.description: Dotted path to regular expression. Every clause must match for the rule to fire.

resolve.description: Enrichment rules, run in order after triage and before the ticket is written. Each finds one Nautobot object the payload names and attaches it.

name.description: Unique within the topic. A later rule scopes on this name.

path.description: Dotted path to the value naming the object. Absent from the payload is a miss; present but empty is a skip.

model.description: `app_label.model` string. Must appear in `attachable_object_types`, or the consumer refuses to start.

field.description: Field to look the value up by, case-insensitively. Must be a field on that model.

scope.description: Relation field on this rule's model to the name of an earlier rule, whose object pins the lookup. An interface name is unique per device, not globally.

triage.description: Whether this topic's accepted events go to LLM triage, when triage is enabled at all.
